tasks.gr7-matter-mixtures-acids-and-bases-t2: Topic: Matter, mixtures, acids and bases. Cover particle model ideas, mixtures, solutions, acids, bases, indicators, and simple evidence of chemical change. Ask Grade 7 learners to classify substances, choose separation methods, interpret indicator results, and reason from particle diagrams.
tasks.gr7-processing-materials-and-properties-: Topic: Processing materials and properties. Cover natural and processed materials, hardness, flexibility, shaping, joining, and sustainability. Ask Grade 7 learners to select materials for a purpose, explain safe processing steps, and evaluate product choices against design needs.
tasks.gr7-periodic-table-t2: Topic: Introduction to the Periodic Table. Cover elements, Mendeleev in the 1860s, symbols of the first 20 elements, and metals on the left, non-metals on the far right and semi-metals between. Ask Grade 7 learners to name elements and symbols, locate categories and describe properties.
